// ============================================================ // Protected Areas — Popup Arcade (Simplified) // Styled but minimal — optimised for Experience Builder // ============================================================ Expects($feature, "name", "code", "area_ha", "iso", "type", "country", "region") var f = $feature var area = Text(Round(f.area_ha, 0), "#,###") + " ha" var FLAG = Dictionary("CMR","🇨🇲","COD","🇨🇩","GNQ","🇬🇶","COG","🇨🇬","CAF","🇨🇫","GAB","🇬🇦","EQG","🇬🇶") var flag = IIf(HasKey(FLAG, f.iso), FLAG[f.iso], "🌍") var banner = "
" + "
" + f.name + "
" + "
" + flag + " " + f.country + "
" + "
Protected Area
" var crumb = "
📍 " + f.country + IIf(!IsEmpty(f.region), " › " + f.region, "") + "
" var body = "
" + "" + "" + "" + "" + "" + "
Superficie" + area + "
ISO3" + f.iso + "
Type" + f.type + "
Code" + f.code + "
" var popup = "
" + banner + crumb + body + "
" return { type: "text", text: popup }
